inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_AMIHUD_ILLIQUIDITY_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. For every hourly subinterval of the latest complete UTC day, compute abs(close/open-1)/(close*base volume), average exactly 24 values, then divide by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day values. Admit the unchanged DRA signal only when this ratio is at or below the frozen threshold. Zero volume, incomplete days, later bars, quote-volume invention, spread substitution, alternate lookbacks, transforms or thresholds are forbidden.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen Amihud-style price-impact DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and frozen 0.8/1.2 neighbors. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime liquidity filter or Trading authorization.
stop_conditions: Before corpus or outcome access, validate the exact task, dispatch, intent and strategy path; re-hash every non-null input and require a clean branch whose HEAD equals origin. Any mismatch is DRA_AMIHUD_ILLIQUIDITY_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
Read only the listed files, task messages and exact sealed TSV. Do not inspect another research artifact, current server state, post-2024 bar, forward outcome or OOS.
Require corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd, exactly 52,608 finite contiguous H1 OHLCV rows through 2025-01-01. Do not repair a failure.
Require the committed declarative, equal-capital and base DRA runners at frozen task hashes. Import and run them without editing, monkey-patching, wrapping or changing economics.
Use exactly the unchanged parent and three frozen Amihud-style variants 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2. Do not run another threshold, lookback, formula, relation, volume transform, spread estimator or filter.

For each complete UTC day average exactly 24 abs(open-close return)/(close*base volume) hourly values, compare with the prior 20-day median, and fail closed on non-positive volume or an incomplete day.
Keep Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and folds 2020-2024 fixed. Historical Validation is development evidence, not clean OOS.
Return DRA_AMIHUD_ILLIQUIDITY_PRIOR_RETAIN only if every frozen primary and neighbor gate passes; otherwise valid paired evidence returns DRA_AMIHUD_ILLIQUIDITY_BRANCH_CLOSE without tuning.
Return DRA_AMIHUD_ILLIQUIDITY_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT for any input, data, parity, arithmetic, accounting or required-field failure. Do not partially classify a window or request permission.
A retained prior permits at most one separately frozen hypothesis. It is not alpha, a candidate, OOS, a runtime filter, deployment or Trading authorization.

Stop without permission if an action requires an unlisted file, dependency, network, server call, post-2024 evidence, outcome-dependent change, OOS, candidate action or Trading action. Preserve exact missing proof.
